title: TOR330 – TOR DES GÉANTS (2026 edition race page)
claims: The TOR330 race page lists 330 km, 24,000 m of elevation gain, a maximum time of 150 hours, and start and finish in Courmayeur, Valle d'Aosta, Italy.
The 2026 edition runs from 13 to 19 September 2026, starting in two groups at 10:00 and 12:00 on 13 September, and the finish must be reached by 18:00 on 19 September 2026.

The page states that the organisation imposes no compulsory stages and that the winner is the runner who completes the race in the shortest time, deciding when and how long to stop for rest and refreshment.
The route runs at the foot of the highest Four-Thousanders of the Alps and through the Gran Paradiso Natural Park and the Mont Avic Regional Park.
The 2026 edition offers 1,100 bibs, and the awards ceremony takes place on 20 September 2026 at 11:00 at Parco Bollino.
The page links seven split GPX files, one full-track GPX, an elevation profile PDF and a timetable PDF/XLSX.
